video.agency.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1第1行第7格至第2行第6格（1.50–3.25秒），我持续保持右掌托火的站姿，面对不断接近的目标没有可辨认的投掷动作；直到第2行第7–8格（3.50–3.75秒）才明显出手。规定的预备阶段在1.50秒结束，此后应每秒攻击一次；这里出现了额外的原地等待，未及时压制正在逼近的威胁。；[食尸鬼·claude] Judged as the Ghoul. ① 0:00.000–0:01.750 (row 1, cells 1–8): the two of us (there may even be a third small figure) are still tiny shapes deep on the right side of the road. Our size and position barely change across 8 cells. By the spec (1.5 s at about 6 m/s, closing to about 14 m) we should be visibly getting bigger. Instead it looks like we are waiting in place or barely creeping forward. That breaks the charge requirement ('fast, smooth, nonstop at full speed'). ② 0:03.750–0:04.250 (row 2 cell 8, row 3 cells 1–2): the front ghoul gets right up to her, only about 3–4 m away. It then stands upright facing her instead of being knocked into a tumble at about 9 m. Standing straight up at close range and just taking hits is not how a ghoul whose only goal is to tackle her would act. ③ 0:04.750–0:05.750 (row 3 cells 4–8): the fire pillar comes up under the ghoul that is close to her and in the middle of the frame, and blows it away. In the spec, the pillar should hit the one circling in from the roadside, so who does what is mixed up. ④ 0:07.000–0:08.250 (row 4 cells 5–8, row 5 cells 1–2): the remaining ghoul mostly stands upright at about 4–6 m and takes hits. It shows a hit reaction, but between hits it doesn't throw itself back into the charge on all fours. It looks more like it is standing still and getting hit. Overall, the waiting and standing-still behavior is clear, so I judge fail.

video.gaze.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1第3行第3–7格（4.50–5.50秒）无法明确辨认我是否完成了规格要求的“转头锁定绕行目标，再转回前方目标”；第5行第4格至第6行第5格（8.75–11.00秒）也无法确认视线是否跟随目标落地。拼图中我的脸部过小，眼神及上述关键转头方向拿不准，无法确认全程持续锁定应看的对象，按要求判fail。；[食尸鬼·claude] Judged as the Ghoul. ① 0:00.000–0:02.500 (rows 1–2): the ghouls are tiny figures in the distance, and at contact-sheet size I can't make out whether our heads face left toward her. ② 0:03.750–0:04.250 (row 2 cell 8, row 3 cells 1–2): the ghoul standing upright at close range seems to be turned toward her. But at 4.0 s its head and face are angled toward the camera, and I can't confirm its eyes are locked on her. ③ 0:06.000–0:06.500 (row 4 cells 1–3): the remaining ghoul's head direction is unclear while it moves along the roadside. ④ 0:08.250 (row 5 cell 2): its body faces her but its head is turned to the side, and it isn't yet in the fall-exempt state (it only falls at 8.5 s). The thumbnails are too small to verify gaze frame by frame, and several frames look like the head is turned toward the camera, so with this much uncertainty I judge fail. 5.25–5.75 s (thrown by the pillar) and after 8.5 s (down on the ground) are exempt cases and were not counted.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Watching the 4fps contact sheet cold, the story is clear. 0–3.5s: a red-robed woman with long red hair stands on the left of a forest road, a flame burning in her hand. Several grey, hunched creatures come at her from the background along the road (they're clearly getting closer at 2.5–3.5s). 3.75–4.0s: the lead creature reaches her and has a fire glow on its chest. 4.75s: a ball of fire bursts out of the ground under that creature. 5.0–5.75s: it turns into a huge pillar of fire that fills the screen, and the creature is thrown into the air and lands on the ground. 6.0–8.25s: a second creature comes forward. She fires fireballs from both hands at it (the fireball on its body is clearly visible at 7.25–8.0s). At 8.5s it reels back and falls. 8.75–9.75s: bodies lie on the ground with dust rising. 10.0–12.75s: the bodies have turned into white skeletons, and she stands in a fire-holding pose with no enemies left. Who cast (the red-robed mage), what (fireballs plus a pillar of fire from the ground), who was hit (the charging creatures), and the result (they die and become skeletons) can all be read without a script. Minor issues that don't stop it reading: (1) at 5.25–5.5s the creature thrown by the fire pillar looks more like a tan-skinned muscular human, which doesn't match the grey creature design at 4.0s. (2) The bodies go from corpses at 9.75s to skeletons at 10.0s with no shot of them burning, so the change is sudden. (3) At 4.75s the fire comes up from the ground and I can't see it leave her hand, so how she cast it is a little less clear.
